name: Dorm kit
summary: Furnish someone's dorm room on a budget: an empty room drawn from above with dashed spots, a tray of Marketplace finds with friends' free leftovers first; tap a find and it drops into its spot while the budget bar runs down, then send the list.
useWhen: 'my little sister starts at eastfield in the fall, budget is like $150'
help furnishing a dorm room cheap from marketplace
anyone have stuff they're getting rid of for a freshman's room
setting up a new room for someone with friends' leftovers and cheap finds
what does a dorm actually need lol
dontUseWhen: checking whether one big piece fits a room (use room-fit)
a group shopping list for an apartment (use grocery)
sorting your own stuff before moving out (use box-sorter)

where.description: Short line: relation, hall, move-in date

finds.description: 3 to 12 finds: name, the spot it fills (lamp, chair, rug, fridge, shelf, mirror, plant, bins), price in cents, and from: a friend's first name when it's their free leftover

placed.description: Finds already in the room: find index, who added it, a short line
